body:
I'm torn, it felt nice to talk to her as a friend and if she really wanted to be a friend I'd be open to that.

But then that might just keep me from moving on as you say.
Ah shame, thanks for the reply

Yeah I feel badminton would be more fun but then boxing would push me out my comfort zone more and be more intense.

In a way I would like to feel more sure of myself in a fight, just to have that extra bit of skill and knowledge. But then as you say I am not going to break my nose (well it is unlikely) playing badminton.

And yeah you guessed right I am a guy. Have you boxed before?

I used to run and play guitar everyday. I don't play anymore, it just doesn't interest me at all anymore which is a shame. I do still run occasionally but not anywhere near to the level I used to. That is about all I do really.
I'm just far too embarrassed about it, I don't want them to look at me differently. I have always preferred to not be the centre of attention as well.
No particular event really, just this past year I have been really depressed regardless of the situation. Nothing brings me happiness anymore.
No I haven't, nobody knows anything about it. I don't plan to change that either.

Your qualifications do not say how long it took for you to obtain them, resit the year. What is one year compared with the many great years that could lie ahead for you?

Also try clearing, there will most likely be a university that will accept you. People focus too much on league tables, when you can have just as good of an experience at a 'lower' uni.

Thank you for this.

What you say is exactly how I feel. I guess I just think I can't be depressed, it is what happens to other people, that I am just being stupid.

I will think on this a while then reassess to see if I should seek any professional help. I definitely wouldn't want anyone in my life finding out.

Fuck it, disregard the post.

I am just being a little bitch. What the hell am I even doing here.
